verdict.rationale: Trello's docs claim it can 'automate tasks and workflows' (trello-docs-3), so an automation layer exists, but nothing in the evidence shows time-based or recurring triggers. The calendar sync and due-date features are not scheduled jobs. missing for 10: explicit evidence of scheduled/recurring automation triggers (e.g., daily/weekly/monthly rules), documentation of how schedules are configured, API or programmatic control of scheduled workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
